description: This file defines a React component for a marketplace page within a career development app. It includes data types for milestones, role plans, opportunities, and functions for parsing state, rendering opportunity cards, and managing UI state. The component displays personalized opportunity recommendations based on user roadmap progress, with sections for career context, roadmap suggestions, skill gaps, exploration, and personalized picks.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.description: Type representing a project milestone with optional tags and stage.

classes.name: RolePlan
classes.description: Type representing a role-specific plan with deltas and milestones.

classes.name: RoadmapState
classes.description: Type representing the user's current roadmap state with active role and plans.

classes.name: Opportunity
classes.description: Type representing an opportunity with metadata such as provider, skills, rating, and optional links.

methods.name: safeParseRoadmapState
methods.description: Parses JSON string from localStorage into RoadmapState object, with error handling.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between two bounds.

methods.name: completionSummary
methods.description: Calculates total, done, in-progress, and not-started milestones.

methods.name: countSkillGapsFromDeltas
methods.description: Heuristic to count completed, in-progress, and missing skills based on deltas.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: React hook to detect if user prefers reduced motion.

methods.name: BadgePill
methods.description: React component for rendering a badge with color based on tone.

methods.name: MetricCard
methods.description: React component displaying a metric with label, value, and status tone.

methods.name: OpportunityCard
methods.description: React component displaying opportunity details with icons, badges, and actions.

methods.name: MarketplaceJourneyPage
methods.description: Main React component for the marketplace page, rendering sections with opportunity recommendations, skill gaps, and user progress, based on local storage state.
